1. (Currently Amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __that does not substantially impair embryo viability__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos __after step (c)__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water __and wherein the embryos are agitated in the water for a duration and under conditions that do not substantially impair embryo viability__.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by __lysing the shed cellular material through exposure to cold and then heat followed by agitation__.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are __performed sequentially and then repeated at least once__.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by __lysing the shed cellular material through heating and agitation__.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are __performed sequentially and then repeated at least once__.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with __a cell wall degrading enzyme or enzymatic preparation__.

8. (Original) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME@.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises __purifying or extracting the DNA from the shed cellular material__.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by __using magnetic particles or magnetic bead-based separation to isolate the DNA from the shed cellular material__.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more __immature embryos that retain viability after collection of shed cellular material__.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d) __in a quiescent or stasis condition__.

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is __PCR-based genotyping or marker-based genotyping__.

14. (Original) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and __performing phenotypic analysis or phenotyping of the plant__.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, __whole genome amplification or DNA amplification is performed on the DNA__.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on __their genotype for breeding or propagation purposes__.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __after the selection step__.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 18 wherein __one or more of the steps resulting in selection of embryos or germination of selected embryos is automated or semi-automated__.
